tasks.text: We type letters and words during word processing.
We can start a new paragraph with the Enter key.
The cursor shows where the next character will go.
We can delete to the left with the Backspace key.
We can delete to the right with the Delete key.
We can type capital letters with the Shift key.
It is important to save our work regularly.
Microsoft Word is a popular word processing software.
We separate words from each other with the space key.
We can fix mistakes with the undo button.
